biocontainers.name: bioconductor-sqldataframe
biocontainers.summary: Representation of SQL database in DataFrame metaphor

biotools.summary: Implements bindings for SQL tables that are compatible with Bioconductor S4 data structures, namely the DataFrame and DelayedArray. This allows SQL-derived data to be easily used inside other Bioconductor objects (e.g., SummarizedExperiments) while keeping everything on disk.
